services.title: Private One to One Boxing
services.summary: Structured syllabus coaching from stance and guard through combinations, pad work, and controlled sparring.
services.details: Every session is built around your level, goals, and timeline. Ideal for beginners learning the Sweet Science, intermediate athletes sharpening technique, and competitors preparing for amateur or white collar bouts.

services.title: Competition Preparation
services.summary: Fight camp style coaching for amateur, white collar, and recreational competitors.
services.details: Pad rounds at fight pace, technical sparring, conditioning blocks, and fight week planning. Delivered to England Boxing standards with attention to weight management, recovery, and corner strategy.

services.title: Group Pad Classes
services.summary: Community pad sessions with structured mitt rotations and combination building for all levels.
services.details: High energy group coaching focused on hand speed, defensive responsibility, and fitness boxing with real technique. A strong entry point before moving into private coaching.

services.title: Boxing Strength and Conditioning
services.summary: Sports specific gym work that supports punching power, trunk stiffness, and ring endurance.
services.details: Accessory drills including anti rotation core work, medicine ball throws, posterior chain development, and leg drive programming. Integrated with your boxing schedule, not generic gym training.

services.title: Youth Boxing Development
services.summary: Technical fundamentals for young athletes with stance discipline, guard structure, and controlled pad work.
services.details: Coaching for developing amateur boxers with safeguarding, patience, and syllabus based progression. Suitable from age 5 with parent consultation for younger athletes.
locations: Putney and Roehampton ABA Boxing Club

services.title: Online One to One Coaching
services.summary: Remote technical coaching, programme design, and session review for clients who train independently.
services.details: Video breakdown, homework drills, and weekly programming for boxing technique and conditioning when you cannot train in person across London.

pricing.name: Private Coaching
pricing.description: One to one boxing and personal training at GYMBOX and partner gyms across London.

pricing.name: Express Pad Session
pricing.description: Focused pad rounds for busy schedules. Ideal for technique maintenance between full sessions.

pricing.name: Group Pad Class
pricing.description: Community pad sessions including Gymboxing and Counterpunch classes at GYMBOX.

pricing.name: Sparring Development
pricing.description: Extended technical sparring blocks for athletes building ring confidence and fight pace.

pricing.name: Free Consultation
pricing.description: Initial consultation to assess goals, experience, availability, and the right coaching pathway.
